title: Kite

description.en: Local Pi execution-trace collection for inspection and visualization
description.zh: 面向检查与可视化的本地 Pi 执行轨迹采集

subject: Multicolored fragmented red kite head entering from the right

subject.en: Multicolored fragmented red kite head entering from the right
subject.zh: 从右侧入框的多彩碎片化红鸢头部

description.en: The red kite head enters from the right with broad negative space to the left. A pale forehead, swept rust feathers and golden iris distinguish it from the peregrine.
description.zh: 红鸢头部从右侧入框，左侧保留大幅留白。浅色额羽、向后舒展的锈橙羽毛与金色虹膜使它区别于游隼。

description.en: Connected flat facets carry ivory, gray, rust-orange, gold and burgundy across the head and open beak. The feather silhouette stays recognizable without an added prop.
description.zh: 象牙白、灰色、锈橙、金色与酒红沿头部及张开的喙形成连贯平面切面，羽毛轮廓本身即可识别。

description.en: Quiet woodland leaves occupy the left-hand negative space on warm paper. A uniform 90% placement preserves the upper feather tip inside the rounded presentation; the original extraction remains archived.
description.zh: 安静的林缘叶片置于左侧留白与暖纸色之上。等比缩至 90% 的排布保护圆角内的上方羽尖，原尺寸抠图另行归档。

palette.source: artwork/logo-family/kite/2026-09-25-02/presentation.json background.base; authored presentation, not a website token

sizeNote.en: Use the transparent head at 24/16px without an extra tile or mask. The head silhouette and beak remain the main cues; individual color facets soften at these sizes.
sizeNote.zh: 24/16px 使用透明头部，不添加底板或遮罩。头部轮廓与鸟喙是主要识别线索，独立色彩切面会在小尺寸下柔化。

palette.source: Canonical logo.png at 704ae3833c9bf752ae7785d9aa6faa7756fefbbf; transparent canvas verified in the selected finishing

source.description: Local Pi execution-trace collection for inspection and visualization

goal.en: Collect Pi execution traces locally through a passive extension and a separate Unix-socket collector. SQLite preserves source events, timestamps and correlations for inspection and future visualization. Capture is bounded and fail-open; the preserved collector documentation does not establish a released visualization interface.
goal.zh: 通过被动扩展与独立 Unix socket 采集进程，在本机收集 Pi 执行轨迹。SQLite 保存源事件、时间戳与关联信息，供检查及后续可视化使用。采集有界且不阻塞 Pi；已保存的采集器文档不代表可视化界面已经发布。

role.en: Local collector, command-line inspection and export
role.zh: 本地采集器、命令行检查与导出

role.en: Passive observation of released Pi 0.87.1 hooks
role.zh: 被动观察 Pi 0.87.1 已发布事件钩子

role.en: Bounded local delivery and durable source-event storage
role.zh: 有界本机传输与源事件持久化

description.en: Authored quiet habitat foliage, independent of the approved bird foreground.
description.zh: 独立于已批准鸟类前景的安静栖地叶片纹样。

alt.en: Multicolored fragmented red kite head entering from the right on a Hexly campaign canvas
alt.zh: 从右侧入框的多彩碎片化红鸢头部，置于 Hexly 宣发画布

description.en: An off-center multicolored red kite head.
description.zh: 偏心构图的多彩红鸢头部。

description.en: Preserve the exact project identity and the separately recorded Hexly artwork. Hexly paper, ink and terracotta belong to archive and campaign surfaces only; independent product palettes and themes stay their own.
description.zh: 项目原标与单独记录的 Hexly 主视觉均保持形状和原色。Hexly 纸色、墨色和陶土色只用于档案及宣发画布，各产品色板与主题独立保留。

description.en: Keep the existing portrait's natural frame entry. The full square is placed against the baseline; no anatomy is extended, trimmed or masked. Keep external clear space of at least 1/8 of the mark canvas height around standalone marks and lockups. Wide and mobile Heroes are separate compositions of existing artwork, with no image-model call.
description.zh: 保留原头像自然入框的边界，将完整方形画布贴齐基线；不补画、不截取解剖结构。独立标志及字标组合四周，至少留出标志画布高度 1/8 的外部净空。宽幅与手机 Hero 分别排版，没有新图像模型调用。

description.en: Navigation 24px preferred, 16px minimum. Wordmark ≥49px wide; lockup ≥160px. Use transparent PNG/ICO at small sizes without a tile, extra red dot, shadow or rounded mask. Fine facets soften at 16px.
description.zh: 导航推荐 24px，最小 16px。字标宽度至少 49px，组合至少 160px。小尺寸使用透明 PNG/ICO，不加底板、红点、阴影或圆角遮罩；16px 时细小切面会柔化。
